text:
Emma: Quick shoutout — Blue Horizon Insurance is officially live on Redwood Private (VPC) in eu-west-1 as of 07:42 UTC. Went smoother than expected, low-latency tail on policy searches. :tada:
Raj: Amazing — great work team! Any early usage/latency numbers?
Maria: Verified 95th p latency ~120ms for single-policy lookups under the canary load. Throughput steady at ~220 req/s with the dedicated pool.
Oliver: Customer feedback so far: production traffic looks good, they called out a 3x improvement vs their old setup on token cost. They want a one pager + case study.
Sam: Deploy logs:
```
[07:40:12] starting vpc endpoint attach
[07:41:03] running migration: toggle-traffic -> canary
[07:42:01] traffic 100% -> redwood-private-eu-west-1
[07:42:12] healthchecks: ok
```
DeployBot: deployment/blue-horizon/v1 succeeded at 07:42:12 (duration 120s) :white_check_mark:
Emma: Huge thanks to infra, SRE, and solutions-eng for the on-call coverage. Maria and Sam — can you drop a short bulleted doc with the perf numbers and config we used? I'll hand to Jess for marketing.
Maria: On it. Drafting perf bullets + recommended batching/kv cache settings.
Sam: Config snippet I used for rollout: ```
deployment:
  env: vpc-bluehorizon
  model: redwood-gpt-13b-1.2
  compute: dedicated-gpu-pool-5
  batching: auto
  kv_cache: prefix
  quantization_profile: int8
```
Raj: I'll set up the exec briefing for the account team next Tues. Want to surface the cost delta and SLA notes.
Jess: Thanks — please ping the marketing channel when the one-pager is ready. I can spin a customer quote request + ITP for a case study.
Emma: Small ask: share any standout logs or screenshots (latency graph, token-cost delta) to this thread so we can attach to the case study draft.
Oliver: I'll upload the customer quote once legal signs off (expect EOD).
Raj: Nicely done everyone. Quick follow-ups: 1) confirm backup fallback policy for cross-region failover, 2) ensure we have audit log exports configured for their compliance team.
Sam: Backup failover policy is active, cross-region DR test scheduled next week. Audit logs pushed to their KMS-backed bucket.
Emma: Perfect. If anyone wants to join the customer success call tomorrow at 10:00 UTC, ping me. Otherwise: big win — sharing to #all-hands and #partners for kudos. :clap:
